title: Profile Flame
summary: Profile flame explorer for a CPU profile (V8 .cpuprofile, Chrome trace JSON or speedscope JSON; convert pprof to speedscope first): a flame chart by time, merged flame graph, icicle and inverted view on one zoomable canvas; a CPU-busy strip whose brush restricts the tree to a window; a top-functions table (file:line, self, total, samples) linked both ways with the canvas; callers, callees and a zoom path; search with share of time; and a second profile compared by delta. Send to Agent (S) posts the hot path the user picked: a short summary message with hotpath.json and collapsed.txt for the agent to grep. Pick it for where CPU time goes, or what changed between two runs.

view.description: Starting view: flamechart (time order), flamegraph (merged stacks), icicle (merged, top down) or inverted (callers of the leaves).

metric.description: Frame width and table sort: total (time under the frame) or self (time spent in the frame itself).

focus.description: Function name to zoom to on load, exact as in the profile (the widest frame of that name). Empty = fit the whole profile.

search.description: Starting search, matched as a case-insensitive substring of function names. The header shows its share of total time.

timeRange.description: Restrict the tree and table to a window, [fromMs, toMs] on the profile clock (first sample = 0). Empty = the whole profile. The density strip shows the brush.

compare.description: auto: with two profiles attached, profile B is compared against profile A and frames are coloured by delta (B minus A). off: never compare.

minPx.description: Hide frames narrower than this many pixels (0 to 20). Raise it to declutter a large profile.

colorBy.description: Frame colour: name (a stable hue per function), service, module, or delta (set automatically when comparing).

customScript.description: JS run last as (t3template, options) to bolt on controls, panels, buttons and presets. See boltOn.

controls.description: Starting values for bolt-on controls, { controlId: value }, applied when customScript adds them (a saved edit wins).

boltOn.summary: options.customScript runs once as new Function('t3template', 'options', code) after the profile has loaded and the canvas, density strip, table and history exist. Read and drive the view through t3template.instances: spantree (t3kit.spantree: get, set, range, zoomTo, locate, top, selection, collapsed, density), density (t3kit.chart, the CPU-busy strip), grid (t3kit.datagrid, the top-functions table) and history. spantree.set and grid.set are silent: call t3template.refresh() after them so the header, Frame, Called By, Calls, Zoom Path and table update. Brush a window with setValues({ range: [fromMs, toMs] }), which also moves the strip's brush; instances.spantree.range() changes the tree only. Every control edit is one undo step. Errors log '[t3template] customScript error: ...' and show in a dismissible banner. This is a data template (pipeline 'data'): addImageStage, addShaderStage, EDL hooks and addAudioFilter throw; bolt on through controls, panels, toolbar buttons, presets and the instances.
api: addControl({ id, label?, type: 'slider'|'toggle'|'select'|'color'|'text'|'button', min = 0, max = 1, step?, default?, options?: ['a', { value, label }], placeholder?, rows?, panel?: 'Title' | element from addPanel, onChange?(value, t3template), onClick?(t3template) }) -> { id, element, get(), set(value), setLabel(text) }. Values: slider number, toggle boolean, select the option value, color '#rrggbb', text string. No panel = 'Extras'. User edits run every hook and re-render; onChange runs on user edits only, not on load. Every control edit is one undo step.

addPanel(title | { title, open = true, position = 'top' }) -> the panel body element (append your own nodes; the same title returns the same panel). 'top' = after Zoom Path and before History; 'bottom' = after History.

addToolbarButton(label, onClick(t3template), { shortcut?: 'shift+s' (any key not in reservedShortcuts), title? }) -> button in the header tools.   refresh() re-renders the header, Frame, Zoom Path and table after silent spantree or grid changes.

export() -> Promise<{ files: [{ name, type, size, width, height }] }>: the canvas as a PNG at 2x (the Export button), sent to t3.workspace.attach and downloaded. Send to Agent (S) is not part of export(); during the user's click or key press it posts a short summary message with hotpath.json {profile, view, selectedPath, selfMs, totalMs, topSelf, range?, compare?} and collapsed.txt (folded stacks of the selected subtree, weights in microseconds). Throws on failure.

getValues() -> { view, metric, search, zoom: [function names, outermost first], range: [fromMs, toMs] | null, controls }.   setValues({ view?, metric?, search?, zoom?, range? }, label?) -> Promise<values>: strict (unknown keys throw). zoom takes function names and zooms to each frame in turn (the widest frame of that name); [] fits. range [fromMs, toMs] or null brushes the tree. One undo step.

addPreset(name, { view?, metric?, search?, zoom?, range? }) / applyPreset(name): a preset is a view, as setValues takes it. Presets and history steps also hold the zoom path and the brush.   on('change', cb(values)) -> off.

instances: { spantree (t3kit.spantree: the canvas; top() rows carry file, line and samples), density (t3kit.chart: the CPU-busy strip, rows { ms, 'busy ms' }, 200 bins, (idle) and (program) excluded), grid (t3kit.datagrid: the top functions; columns function, file:line, self ms, total ms, samples (spans for evented traces) and, when comparing, delta ms), history (t3kit.history) }. A click on a frame zooms into it (one 'Zoom to X' step).
